values.value: Players that have been trapped by a Trapper or Retributionist-Trapper. Trapped players will have their interactors' roles logged and sent to the relevant Trapper. The Trapper is notified if the trap attacked someone, and if not, they get a list of roles that interacted with their targets.

values.value: The Cult is a group that can gain massive numbers of followers in one go. It may be weak at the start, but do not underestimate them as their powerful growth as it may overrun you. The Cult is led by the Whisperer.

values.name: English
values.value: The Cabal is an organisation that's similar to the Syndicate. They operate covertly by secretly recruiting people to join their group. The Cabal starts off very strong, making them a high-priority threat. They are led by the Jackal.

values.name: English
values.value: The Undead are a group of bloodthirsty vampires who slowly grow their numbers. The longer the game progresses, the higher their elimination priority becomes. They are led by the Dracula.

values.name: English
values.value: The Reanimated are individuals who have died yet hold a grudge against the living. This is facilitated by the Necromancer, their leader. Extended periods without confirmed deaths increase suspicion of Necromancer activity.
